changes.text: A focused, unselected segment shows a solid inset `--ss-primary` ring (was a `--ss-primary-soft` wash at about 1.5:1).
Under `dir="rtl"`, ArrowLeft / ArrowRight follow reading direction, in the Svelte component and in `dssoca/vanilla.js`. Up / Down and Home / End stay logical.
The hairline dividers use `border-inline-start` instead of `border-left`, so they sit between segments in RTL.

Plain-HTML behaviour in `dssoca/vanilla.js`: click and Arrow / Home / End selection over `.ss-segmented > .segment[role="radio"]` markup. The root emits a bubbling `ss:change` event with `{ value, index }`, where `value` is the segment's `data-value` attribute or its label text.
`disabled` prop disables the whole control: every segment is `disabled` and skipped by keyboard navigation, and the group carries `aria-disabled="true"`. Per-option `disabled` still works.

New component: a compact row of mutually exclusive options (`role="radiogroup"` with `role="radio"` segments) with a bindable `value`, `onChange`, `fullWidth`, `size`, a required `label`, per-option `icon` and `disabled`, and Arrow / Home / End keys that move focus and selection together.
